items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, him and Clarence Muse. ... Otis and Clarence Muse wrote... I think Clarence Muse was the co-writer on 'When The Swallows Come Back To Capistrano.'

ctx.x: I knew he wrote "Sleepy Time Down South."
Yeah, him and Clarence Muse. Leon and his brother...
